summary: Clara Fenwick trains chemists to distinguish a proposed target, isolated material and a released delivery lot on the compound card. The deck covers identity evidence, area-percent purity, quantity and traceability, with a qualitative assignment exercise and explicit release hold points.

slides.title: The card must describe the material
bullets: A drawn target states the synthetic intention.
An isolated compound has physical material and supporting characterisation.
Released material has a documented release decision for a particular delivery lot.
These states must remain distinguishable throughout the card.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Check identity before interpreting purity

rows: Does the assignment describe the isolated material?
Are salt form and stereochemical claims supported?
Can each analytical result be traced to this material?
Does the preparation refer to the same compound card?
Is any unresolved assignment clearly stated?

slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Area-percent purity needs context
bullets: Give purity in area percent and identify the analytical method.
Retain the trace and the integration context behind the reported value.
Area percent describes detected signal; it does not alone establish identity or mass purity.
Raise co-elution, unresolved peaks or handling changes before release.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Quantity and isolated yield
bullets: Record delivered mass in mg and amount in mmol where applicable.
State the material form used for any amount calculation.
Link isolated yield to the preparation and isolated material.
Do not substitute an analytical estimate for material actually recovered.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Trace the delivery lot in both directions
bullets: From the container: find the compound card and delivery lot.
From the card: find the preparation and analytical samples.
From the analytical result: find the material examined.
bullets_right: Check that labels and delivery documentation agree.
Carry forward relevant handling and impurity observations.
Andrew May coordinates sample management; resolve missing links before dispatch.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Hold points that need a decision

rows: Correct the status and seek assignment evidence
Attach the method and underlying trace
Refer the chemical question for a decision
Hold handover until the discrepancy is resolved

slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Exercise: a clean trace, an uncertain assignment
bullets: The target is drawn on the compound card and isolated material is available.
The analytical trace appears clean, but the stereochemical assignment remains open.
Describe the material as isolated with an unresolved assignment.
Refer the requirement to Ruth Calderwood and document the decision; a clean trace does not close the assignment.
slides.notes: Ask participants which statement is supported by the evidence. No numerical acceptance threshold is implied by this exercise.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Record the release decision
bullets: Clara Fenwick reviews the analytical evidence against the agreed requirement.
The card states the delivery lot, decision, date and responsible reviewer.
Any agreed limitation is carried into the chemistry note and handover.
Later evidence is added with a clear explanation of the changed conclusion.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Before the material leaves
bullets: Identity: the assignment and its limits are explicit.
Purity: area percent is linked to method and trace.
Quantity: the stated material and units match the delivery lot.
Traceability: container, card, preparation and analytical samples connect.
Release: the decision is documented and unresolved questions are visible.
